blind.description: A rustic wooden spiral staircase section covering approximately 270 degrees of rotation. It features a central thick carved wooden newel post topped with a round finial ball, winding wooden steps/treads radiating outward, an outer curved timber railing/stringer wall, and an upper landing balustrade/panel post. The surfaces are solid, stylized hand-painted wood grain with warm medium brown/amber tones. All elements are solidly connected with clean geometry and no floating pieces or holes.
blind.from_above: From straight above it appears as an incomplete circular spiral staircase resembling a Pac-Man or roughly three-quarters circular shape, with a round central post finial, radiating wedge-shaped step treads, an outer curved rim, and a flat end at the landing step.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top finial is slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6 ft tall), and the staircase is approximately 4.5 to 5 ft in diameter.
